dct_description_sm: The Beaver Creek site is an experimental road where mitigation techniques, aiming to control permafrost degradation along the Alaska Highway, are being tested since 2008. The site comprises 12 sub-sections including a control sub-section. The natural soil has remained understudied until 2013. The ADAPT Protocol have been applied to study the natural environment. This Protocol aims to create a uniform and easy to compare dataset among the various sites where the contributing researchers usually work.
dct_title_s: Beaver Creek experimental site, ADAPT Protocol: a natural ground study
